Package com.example.wackah_mole

Class Mole

java.lang.Object
com.example.wackah_mole.Mole
public class Mole extends Object
This class represents a mole in digital form The Mole can move throughout the hole network, hide, and attack The Mole is a smart Mole, and has a digital brain (MoleBrain) which is implemented as a reinforced learning model. Overtime the Mole learns how to not got hit by the player, while hitting you.
Author:
John Brittain
